task.description:
Update CHANGELOG.md and resolve ISS-0114.

OUTCOME CONTEXT (from TEST-RUNNER step 5 retry, commit 0299c37):
- The Step 6a INSERT INTO public.tenant slug/NOT-NULL defect IS FULLY RESOLVED (97 → 0 occurrences).
- Net test pass change: +35 passes / -35 fails, no regressions.
- 3 of 7 affected TCs now PASS (TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-05).
- 4 of 7 still FAIL but the defects are distinct from ISS-0114: D1 (resolver LEGACY_RLS fallthrough on TC-TNT-03-01/03), D2 (StoreError.InstanceNotFound on TC-DB-03-01), D3 (DROP TRIGGER C40P01 deadlock on TC-TNT-01-01).

TASKS:

1. Update CHANGELOG.md to record:
   - [WF-03-gh377] ISS-0114 FIXED: tenant-schema routing resolver fallback (pool.zig), Step 6a authoritative public.tenant INSERT (provisioning.zig), backfill migration 1135 (postgres), SHOW search_path post-condition (migrations.zig), test-harness tenant_context.clear() reset. Net +35 passes. Remaining defects filed as ISS-0115/D1, ISS-0116/D2, ISS-0117/D3.

2. Update docs/issues/ISS-0114.json to status RESOLVED with resolution narrative:
   - root_cause: Step 6a INSERT INTO public.tenant SET (id, storage_mode) violating 7 NOT NULL columns (slug, display_name, status, tenant_type, created_at, updated_at) — C23502.
   - resolution: Step 6a now sets all 8 columns. Migration 1135 matches. Resolver fallback in pool.zig unchanged.
   - tests_passing: TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-05.
   - follow_up: 3 distinct defects carried as separate ISS files (D1/D2/D3).
   - related_run: WF03-gh377-20260804.

3. File three follow-up issues via gh issue create (REQUIRED — see §§ No Issue Left Local-Only). Use sequential ISS numbers in docs/issues/. For each:
   - create docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.json with summary/root_cause/acceptance_criteria/repro/status=OPEN
   - gh issue create --title <title> --body "<body>" --label "bug,integration,tenant-routing"
   - record github_issue URL in the JSON

   ISS-0115 (D1): pool.zig resolver still falls through to LEGACY_RLS on TC-TNT-03-01 (search_path stays 'public' instead of tenant_<uuid>) and TC-TNT-03-03 (both conn_a/b stuck on 'public'). The tenant_schemas fallback in resolveAndCacheStorageMode does not trigger for these fixtures, or the storage_mode is set but SET LOCAL is not being honored per-conn under concurrent resets.

   ISS-0116 (D2): TC-DB-03-01 fails with StoreError.InstanceNotFound at event_store/store.zig:337 on store.append. Downstream of tenants now provisioning successfully, exposes a deeper event-store idempotency issue.

   ISS-0117 (D3): TC-TNT-01-01 fails with C40P01 deadlock on DROP TRIGGER during tenant re-provisioning. Migration 1135's DROP TRIGGER appears to race with another test's INSERT INTO public.tenant ON CONFLICT path.

4. Run git add -A; git commit -m 'docs(WF03-gh377): resolve ISS-0114, file ISS-0115/0116/0117'; git push origin feature/WF03-gh377-20260804.

5. Update handoff result, registry.json, orchestrator.log.
acceptance_criteria: gh issue create succeeded for all three new ISS files (verify via gh issue list --search)
Each new GitHub issue has the rco-sync-ref comment
All work committed and pushed to feature/WF03-gh377-20260804
